cells.title: Prosthodontist in Northern Virginia | Dr. Esam Nahlah

props.text: Board-certified prosthodontist. Diplomate of the American Board of Prosthodontics and Fellow of the American College of Prosthodontists. Practicing since 2003, in Northern Virginia since 2013.
Three more years, spent entirely on the hard cases.
Prosthodontics is the specialty concerned with
: implants, crowns, bridges, veneers, dentures and full-mouth rehabilitation. Three years of training beyond dental school.
Practicing since 2003, in Northern Virginia since 2013, and a
Fellow of the American College of Prosthodontists
. Published in national and international scientific journals, and lectures on smile design and dental implants, which is what tends to bring other dentists’ difficult cases to his door.
The home page shows eight of these. Here is the complete record.
Adjunct Faculty, Virginia Commonwealth University, Prosthodontics Postgraduate Program
M.S., Master of Science in Oral Biology
Fellow, International Congress of Oral Implantologists
Associate Fellow, American Academy of Implant Dentistry
CRDTS, Central Regional Dental Testing Service
He teaches the dentists who refer to him.
adjunct faculty at Virginia Commonwealth University
, teaching the residents in its Prosthodontics Postgraduate Program: the dentists who are themselves training to become prosthodontists.
clinical instructor at UCSF School of Dentistry
before relocating, and still runs hands-on courses for other dentists.
, a quarterly symposium for dentists, by dentists.
Techniques he brought in, and keeps current.
Implants placed at the time of extraction where the case allows, removing a healing phase and a separate surgery.
Placement through a surgical guide generated from the cone-beam scan, so each post lands at the planned angle and depth.
Scanned rather than molded, which removes a step patients dislike and a source of dimensional error.
The half most surgeons hand off. Planning and restoring in the same practice is the reason the final teeth match the plan.
The part that is not on a certificate.
In his own words: time with his wife and family, motorcycles, hiking, boating, and more recently cycling.
Two offices, one team, and a laboratory in the building. If you have been told your case is too complex, that combination is usually why it is not.
The specialty applied: what an implant is and how it is planned.
Six patients filmed at the practice.
Have the specialist look at it.
The 3D scan and a straight answer. Second opinions on implant surgery are free.
Implant dentistry and prosthodontics for Northern Virginia, rebuilding smiles that other practices call too complex.
